newsitem.title: EU: Reuter European Court of Justice Diary for Tuesday, May 2 - Thursday, May 15.
newsitem.headline: Reuter European Court of Justice Diary for Tuesday, May 2 - Thursday, May 15.

text.p: (All venues Luxembourg, Plateau de Kirchberg)
TUESDAY, MAY 6

COURT OF JUSTICE, PLENARY COURT (0930/0730 GMT) - Opinion C-20/96 Snares: free movement of persons. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of article 4, paragraph 2(a) and 10(a) of Council regulation 1408/71 of June 14, 1971, on social security schemes for employed persons and their families moving within the EU as amended and updated by Council regulation 2001/83 of June 2, 1983. Disability living allowance. Exclusion from the meaning of article 4, paragraph 1 of regulation 1408/71. - Oral procedure C-4/96 NIFPO: agriculture. Request for preliminary ruling. Annex VII of Council resolution of November 3, 1976, on certain external aspects of the Community creation as of January 1, 1977, of a 200-mile fishing zone. Lack of formal adoption. Effects on the validity of quotas allocated in conformity with article 3 of Council regulation 3362/94 of December 20, 1994, laying down admissible capture levels for certain fish stocks and groups for 1995, and the conditions in which they may be fished. Compatibility of said quotas with the common fisheries policy and in particular with Council regulation 3760/92 of December 20, 1992, setting up a common fisheries and aquaculture policy.

SIXTH CHAMBER (0930/0730 GMT) - Opinion C-122/96 Saldanha: principles of community law. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of EC treaty article 6. National law requiring foreigners to advance a "cautio judicature solvi" in cases of intended action by an individual or foreign jurisdiction. Individual possessing two nationalities, one of which is not of a member state.

COURT OF FIRST INSTANCE, SECOND CHAMBER (enlarged) (0915/0715 GMT) - Judgment T-195/95 Guerin Automobiles v/ Commission: competition. Action for incompetence, finding that the Commission illegally abstained from taking a decision following a complaint lodged by the claimant on the basis of EC treaty article 85 and of Commission regulation 123/85 and concerning the imposition by Nissan France of a concession scheme incompatible with said regulation. Appeal for compensation to cover damages allegedly caused by the Commission's conduct.
WEDNESDAY, MAY 7

COURT OF JUSTICE, FIFTH CHAMBER (0930/0730 GMT) - Judgment C-223/95 Moksel: agriculture. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of EC treaty article 9, paragraph 2 and of article 8, paragraph 1 of Commission regulation 3665/87 of November 27, 1987, setting up common export repayment schemes for agricultural products. Cattle from former East Germany, in West Germany prior to the economic and monetary union between the two Germanys, with a view to slaughter and export to the Soviet Union. Export prior to unification. - Judgment joined cases C-321/94, C-322/94, C-323/94, C-324/94 Pistre: free movement of goods. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of EC treaty articles 30 and 36 and of Council regulation 2081/92 of July 14, 1992 on the protection of geographic indications and names of origin for agricultural products and food stuffs. National regulation making the use of the indication "mountain" subject to ministerial authorisation. Cooked meats.

SIXTH CHAMBER (0930/0730 GMT) - Oral procedure C-42/96 Immobiliare SIF: taxation. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of articles 4, 7 and 10 of Council directive 69/335/EEC of July 17, 1969, on indirect taxes on the raising of capital as amended by Council directive 73/80/EEC of April 9, 1973, on the setting of common taxes on assets. Tax on growth in property value. - (1030/0830 GMT) Oral procedure C-314/96 Djabali: external relations. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of article 39 of the EEC/Algeria co-operation accord approved in the name of the EU by Council regulation 2210/78. Prohibition of all discrimination based on nationality in matters of social security. Benefits for the adult disabled. Situation of a future retirement pension holder as mother of a household.

COURT OF FIRST INSTANCE, SECOND CHAMBER (enlarged) (0930/0730 GMT) - Oral procedure T-371/94 British Airways and others v/ Commission: state aid. Annulment of commission decision 94/653 of July 27, 1994, on an increase in Air France's capital. - Oral procedure T-394/94 British Midland Airways v/ Commission: state aid. Annulment of commission decision 94/653 of July 27, 1994, on an increase in Air France's capital.
PROVISIONAL AGENDA FOR TUESDAY-THURSDAY, MAY 13-15
TUESDAY, MAY 13

COURT OF JUSTICE, PLENARY COURT (0930/0730 GMT) - Opinion C-353/95 P Tierce Ladbroke v/ Commission: state aid. - Opinion joined cases C-359/95 P, C-379/95 P Commission v/ Ladbroke Racing: competition. - Oral procedure C-317/95 Canadane Cheese Trading: free movement of goods. - (1130/0930 GMT) Oral procedure C-15/96 Schoening-Kougebetopoulou: free movement of persons.
COURT OF FIRST INSTANCE, THIRD CHAMBER (enlarged)(0930/0830 GMT) - Oral procedure joined casses T-28/95, T-110/95, T-133/95, T-204/95 IECC v/ Commission: competition.
WEDNESDAY, MAY 14

COURT OF FIRST INSTANCE, SECOND CHAMBER (enlarged) (0930/0830 GMT) - Judgment joined cases T-70/92, T-71/92 Florimex v/ Commission: competition. - Judgment T-77/94 VGB and others v/ Commission: competition.
THURSDAY, MAY 15
COURT OF JUSTICE, PLENARY COURT (0930/0730 GMT) - Opinion C-409/95 Marschall: social policy.
FIRST CHAMBER (0930/0730 GMT) - Judgment C-405/95 Bioforce: free movement of goods.

FIFTH CHAMBER (0930/0730 GMT) - Opinion C-244/95 Moskof: agriculture. - Oral procedure C-360/95 Commission v/ Spain: free movement of persons. - Oral procedure C-361/95 Commission v/ Spain: free movement of persons. - (1530/1330 GMT) Oral procedure C-384/95 Landboden-Agrardienste: taxation.

SIXTH CHAMBER (0930/0730 GMT) - Opinion C-55/96 Job Centre: free movement of persons. - Oral procedure C-369/95 Somalfruit: agriculture. - (1100/0900 GMT) Oral procedure C-356/95 Witt: agriculture. - (1530/1330 GMT) Oral procedure C-280/95 Commission v/ Italy: state aid. - (1600/1400 GMT) Oral procedure C-206/96 Commission v/ Luxembourg: environment and consumers.
